import '@design-schema/lit';
import { html } from 'lit';
import type { TableRow } from '@design-schema/lit';

const INVOICES: TableRow[] = [
  { id: 'a', invoice: 'INV-1', due: '12 Sep', amount: 100 },
  { id: 'b', invoice: 'INV-2', due: '19 Sep', amount: 200 },
];

html`
      <ds-table
        caption="Open invoices"
        .columns=${[
    {
      key: 'invoice',
      header: 'Invoice',
      isRowHeader: true,
      render: (row) => html\`<ds-link href="#${String(row.id)}" label=${String(row['invoice'])}></ds-link>\`,
    },
    { key: 'due', header: 'Due', hideBelow: 'prose' },
    { key: 'amount', header: 'Amount', align: 'end', sortable: true },
  ]}
        .data=${INVOICES}
        .sort=
        .defaultSort=
        selectable=none
        .selected=
        .defaultSelected=
        responsive=stack
        ?no-sticky-header=
        max-height=none
        density=comfortable
        ?striped=
        .emptyMessage=
        ?loading=
        .rowActions=
        ?pressable-rows=
      ></ds-table>
`;
